name: 编辑部红
description: 源自 rico-md 的「编辑部红」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 12px 40px 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.8; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 48px 0 28px; padding-left: 20px; border-left: 6px solid {{codeText}}; position: relative">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; line-height: 1.4; margin: 40px 0 24px; padding: 16px 24px; background-color: {{codeText}}; border-radius: 4px; position: relative">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: {{codeText}}; line-height: 1.5; margin: 35px 0 20px; padding-left: 16px; border-left: 4px solid {{codeText}}; position: relative">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.5; margin: 30px 0 16px; padding: 8px 12px; background-color: {{codeBg}}; border-left: 3px solid #ff5252">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

strong.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeText}}; color: #fff; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; border: none">{{content}}</th>

tableCell.html: {{content}}

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 40px auto; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, {{codeText}}, transparent); max-width: 200px">
